ops.body: - [loop] **A moment of a walk still open is not said to be mentioned** (fix note-camera-photo, RF7): the viewer's "Mentioned in a note" line, its Open note and the picker it opens read the feed's moments (`pool.views`, `pool.byId`), which leave a walk still open out, so a photo the page's camera kept on a walk does not say which note mentions it until the walk ends. A mention itself resolves across the open walk since that fix (`mentioned`, `lib/refs.ts`).
